properties.html: When all the students of a school are arranged in columns of 18 students, then 6 students remain in the last column. When all of them are arranged in columns of 14, then also 6 students remain in the last column. Which of the following can be the total number of students in the school?

questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:

When the students are arranged in columns of 18 students, then the arrangement is 6 students short of equal divisions. When the students are arranged in columns of 14 students, then the arrangement is 6 students short of equal divisions. Therefore, the total number of students can be 6 short of any multiple of the LCM of 18 and 14. Only 624 satisfy this condition.
